fact: Car 44 crossed the white line at pit entry.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 4 d) of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Notes (item 12.2, document 16).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 44 crossed the white line at pit entry when entering the pits. The manoeuvre was not considered dangerous in any way, therefore the least severe penalty available is imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 44 Crossing The Line At Pit Entry
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
